notes: Tunable thresholds for the universal grader and LLM-as-judge. Stakeholders editing here change grader BEHAVIOR (how strict it is, how aggressive the gaming defense is, when the judge breaker fires) without touching code. Each entry has a `value` plus a one-line `rationale`. Override priority: env var > this file > built-in default.

grader_response_text_cap_chars.rationale: Cap response text at 32 KB for grading. Real LLM responses rarely exceed 8 KB; cap prevents adversarial padding from blowing up grader latency.

gaming_defense_pct_cap.rationale: Score cap when response lacks substantive narrative + structure. A bag-of-keywords response cannot exceed 60% even if every dim hits.

gaming_min_response_len_chars.rationale: Minimum response length to be considered substantive (escapes the gaming cap).

gaming_min_body_chars_with_structure.rationale: When markdown structure is present, body chars must exceed this to count as 'has narrative + structure'.

structure_boost_max_pp.rationale: Maximum percentage-point boost from a fully-structured response (sections + lists + emphasis).

structure_boost_quality_floor.rationale: Structure quality_score must be >= this to receive any boost.

judge_breaker_consecutive.rationale: LLM-as-judge raises after this many CONSECUTIVE model_call exceptions (CUDA OOM, network, bad temperature).

judge_breaker_total.rationale: LLM-as-judge raises after this many TOTAL exceptions in a single grade run, regardless of pattern.

classifier_rules_weight.rationale: Default rules-vs-LLM blend for the prompt classifier. 0.6 leans toward rules because they're grounded in named signals and never hallucinate.

classifier_llm_max_chars.rationale: Truncate prompt before sending to the classifier LLM call (avoids OOM on long prompts).

image_store_lru_cap.rationale: Maximum number of uploaded images held in memory simultaneously.

deep_judge_max_new_tokens.rationale: Per-call token cap for judge envelope. Tiny envelopes; 320 is generous.

deep_judge_temperature.rationale: Nearly-deterministic verdicts. Cannot be 0 because HF transformers requires > 0 when do_sample=True.

enable_use_case_aware_weighting.rationale: Master switch for prompt-classifier weighting in the universal grader. Set false to fall back to flat dimension weights.

enable_gaming_defense.rationale: Master switch for the bag-of-keywords gaming cap.

enable_structure_boost.rationale: Master switch for the well-structured-response score boost.

enable_section_verification.rationale: Master switch for the §/Article range verification (catches 'RA 8042 §99' = invalid).
